title: Kunal Kemmu's Hindi Comedy Vibe Arrives on Prime Video November 13
excerpt: Kunal Kemmu's Hindi action-comedy Vibe, co-starring Preity G Zinta and Sparsh Shrivastava, premieres on Prime Video on November 13, 2026 after a September theatrical run. It is Kemmu's second film as director, after Madgaon Express.
body:
• Vibe, a Hindi action-comedy written and directed by Kunal Kemmu, premieres on Prime Video on November 13, 2026.
  • Kemmu stars as Hardik alongside Preity G Zinta as Madam H and Sparsh Shrivastava as Bugs.
  • The film was released in theatres on September 18, 2026, and marks Kemmu's second directorial venture after Madgaon Express.
  • Viewers can watch it on Prime Video with a subscription, according to FilmiBeat; no source read for this article stated a separate US release arrangement.

Vibe, the Hindi action-comedy written, directed and headlined by Kunal Kemmu, is making its digital debut on Prime Video. FilmiBeat reported that the film will premiere exclusively on Amazon Prime Video on November 13, 2026, after its theatrical release in September 2026. Amazon MGM Studios, which co-produced and distributed the film, holds its post-theatrical streaming rights, the report said.

The language of the film is Hindi. FilmiBeat described Vibe as a 2026 Hindi action-comedy film, and Gadgets 360 also lists its language as Hindi, its release date as September 18, 2026, and its production companies as Amazon MGM Studios and Drongo Films.

Two friends, one dangerous mission

The film follows two ordinary friends who are forced into a dangerous mission when the nation faces a threat. Kemmu plays Hardik and Sparsh Shrivastava plays Bugs, the two friends at the centre of the story, while Preity G Zinta plays Madam H, who pushes the unprepared duo into action.

New Kerala, reporting the trailer release, said the film follows two inseparable friends whose ordinary lives take an unexpected turn when they are thrust into a dangerous mission, testing their friendship and survival instincts. The cast also includes Vanshika Dhir, with Yashpal Sharma and Dinesh Lal Yadav in pivotal roles.

"What excited us about VIBE was the delicious contradiction at the heart of the film. The situation demands heroes, but the two people caught in the middle are the least likely options."

That assessment came from Nikhil Madhok, Director and Head of Originals, Prime Video (SVOD) and Amazon MGM Studios India, in a statement reported at the trailer launch. Madhok added that the film brings together humour, action and energy intended as a theatrical experience, a point that helps explain the sequence of a cinema release first and a streaming premiere afterwards.

Kemmu's second film as director

Vibe marks Kemmu's second directorial venture after Madgaon Express, according to FilmiBeat. As well as writing and directing, Kemmu produced the film with Chirag Nihalani under the banner of Drongo Films. New Kerala reported that Vibe is the production house's first production, and that Nihalani described it as a special project for Drongo Films from the beginning.

Kemmu himself said he wanted to make a "no-holds-barred entertainer" that audiences could watch in cinemas with family or friends, or on their own. He said the comedy comes from watching ordinary people find themselves in the middle of chaos beyond their control, and that playing one of those characters while also writing, directing and producing meant shifting between different versions of the same madness.

Zinta, for her part, said Madam H "loves her country and will go to any lengths to protect it," and that she enjoyed playing a character with that determination, in remarks reported by New Kerala.

How and when to watch

For streaming viewers, the date to note is November 13, 2026, when Vibe premieres on Prime Video. FilmiBeat said viewers will be able to watch Kemmu and Zinta's action-comedy online through a Prime Video subscription. That follows the film's theatrical release on September 18, 2026, giving audiences who missed it in cinemas a streaming route to the same film.

The streaming premiere also closes the film's release arc: an Amazon MGM Studios film, produced by Drongo Films, made first for the big screen and now arriving on the studio's own streaming platform. For viewers deciding what to watch, the essentials are straightforward — Hindi language, action-comedy, Kemmu and Shrivastava as the two friends, Zinta as the officer who recruits them, and a Prime Video premiere date of November 13, 2026.
